title: Understanding the Model
text: The model shown is a linear regression model with transformations applied to the features. Notice that one feature is raised to the power of $$3$$ and the other is transformed using a natural logarithm. These transformations can help in capturing non-linear relationships.

title: Unique Solution in OLS
text: In ordinary least squares (OLS), a unique solution exists if the design matrix X has full column rank. This means the columns of X are linearly independent.

hintAnswer: Ridge regularization ensures a unique solution by adding a penalty term that prevents multicollinearity issues.
title: Ridge Regularization
text: What effect does adding L2 regularization (Ridge) have on the existence of a unique solution?
choices: Ridge regularization does not affect the existence of a unique solution.
Ridge regularization ensures a unique solution by adding a penalty term that prevents multicollinearity issues.

Ridge regularization makes it harder to find a unique solution.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding a new feature to a model can affect the rank of the design matrix. If the new feature is a linear combination of existing features, it may lead to multicollinearity, affecting the uniqueness of the solution.
